members.name: SetUVRect
members.signature: public void SetUVRect(Float2 offset, Float2 scale)

docs.summary: Sets the sub-rect UV remap applied to generated shapes. Reset to identity by `Reset`.

members.name: AddQuad
members.signature: public void AddQuad(Rect r, Color tint, Float2 uv0, Float2 uv1)

docs.summary: Adds a textured quad spanning `r` in canvas-local pixel space. Vertex order: TL, TR, BR, BL (counter-clockwise when looking down -Z, matching [`GetFullscreenQuad`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.Mesh~GetFullscreenQuad)'s winding so backface culling stays consistent).
Index the next appended vertex will get; add this to Scribe's local indices.

members.name: AddVertex
members.signature: public void AddVertex(Float3 position, Float2 uv, Color32 color)

docs.summary: Append one vertex (position in local pixel space, atlas UV, colour).
Append one triangle index (already offset by [`NextVertex`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.UI.UIMeshBuilder~NextVertex) at append time).

members.name: AddRoundedRect
members.signature: public unsafe void AddRoundedRect(Rect r, float radius, Color tint, int cornerSegments = 6)

docs.summary: Tessellates a rounded rectangle by replacing each corner with an arc of `cornerSegments` triangles. The result is a triangle fan from the rect's center. Use `radius` = 0 for a sharp rect (callers should prefer [`AddQuad`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.UI.UIMeshBuilder~AddQuad) in that case).

members.name: AddTiled
members.signature: public void AddTiled(Rect outer, Float2 tileSize, Color tint)

docs.summary: Tiles a texture across `outer` using tiles of `tileSize` in design pixels. Partial tiles at the right/top edges get UV-clipped so the texture is never visually stretched. Falls back to a single quad if the tile size is invalid.

members.name: AddFilled
members.signature: public void AddFilled(Rect r, Color tint, UI.FillMethod method, int origin, float amount, bool clockwise)

docs.summary: Emits a triangle fan that fills a fraction of `r` per the image fill modes. Horizontal/Vertical clip the rect on one axis; Radial90/180/360 sweep an arc from a corner / edge-midpoint / center. `amount` is clamped to [0,1]. UV is mapped 1:1 to the original rect so the texture appears un-stretched.

members.name: AddNineSlice
members.signature: public void AddNineSlice(Rect outer, Float4 inner, Float4 uvBorders, Color tint)

docs.summary: Adds a nine-slice quad: `outer` is the on-screen rectangle, `inner` is the unstretched center region in *pixel* offsets from the outer rect's edges (left, top, right, bottom). UV space is 0-1 for the source texture, with the same four borders given as normalized fractions in `uvBorders`.

members.name: ClipToRoundedRect
members.signature: public void ClipToRoundedRect(Rect rect, float radius, int cornerSegments = 6)

docs.summary: Intersects the currently-accumulated geometry with a rounded rectangle (Sutherland-Hodgman against a CCW polygon that has `cornerSegments` straight edges per corner arc). Each source triangle is clipped independently; per-vertex UVs and colors are linearly interpolated at the clip intersections so any fill mode (sliced / tiled / filled) keeps its shading. Triangles fully inside take a fast path; triangles fully outside are dropped.
